events_ends_after_starts.name: events_ends_after_starts
events_ends_after_starts.value: "events"."ends_at" is null or "events"."starts_at" is null or "events"."ends_at" > "events"."starts_at"

events_place_all_or_nothing.name: events_place_all_or_nothing
events_place_all_or_nothing.value: ("events"."venue" is null) = ("events"."address" is null) and ("events"."venue" is null) = ("events"."area" is null) and ("events"."venue" is null) = ("events"."city" is null)

events_point_needs_venue.name: events_point_needs_venue
events_point_needs_venue.value: "events"."lat" is null or "events"."venue" is not null

events_point_in_india.name: events_point_in_india
events_point_in_india.value: "events"."lat" is null or ("events"."lat" between 6 and 37.5 and "events"."lng" between 68 and 97.5)

stations_off_peak_all_or_nothing.name: stations_off_peak_all_or_nothing
stations_off_peak_all_or_nothing.value: ("stations"."off_peak_from" is null) = ("stations"."off_peak_to" is null) and ("stations"."off_peak_from" is null) = ("stations"."off_peak_weekdays" is null) and ("stations"."off_peak_from" is null) = ("stations"."off_peak_paise" is null)

stations_off_peak_sane.name: stations_off_peak_sane
stations_off_peak_sane.value: "stations"."off_peak_from" is null or ("stations"."off_peak_from" >= 0 and "stations"."off_peak_from" < "stations"."off_peak_to" and "stations"."off_peak_to" <= 24 and "stations"."off_peak_paise" < "stations"."price_paise")

team_roles_one_open_per_person.name: team_roles_one_open_per_person
team_roles_one_open_per_person.where: "team_roles"."ended_at" is null and "team_roles"."user_id" is not null

ticket_types_sales_end_after_start.name: ticket_types_sales_end_after_start
ticket_types_sales_end_after_start.value: "ticket_types"."sales_end_at" is null or "ticket_types"."sales_start_at" is null or "ticket_types"."sales_end_at" > "ticket_types"."sales_start_at"
